about: MIDI Transform vectors (docs/08-phase-7.md, "MIDI Transform"): Anode.Model's TransformEngine computes these; the server applies them and the editor's TypeScript port must reproduce them exactly. Each case applies `set` to `notes` and `controls` (positions in project ticks, 960 per quarter note) under `signatures` (absent: 4/4 from tick 0) and expects every event back in the order given (changed when matched, unless the mode is selectOnly) and the matching ids in input order. FIELDS (doubles): a note's position = startTick, length = lengthTicks, channel, pitch, velocity, status 144; a controller's position = tick, length 0, channel, pitch = number for controlChange and polyPressure (else 0), velocity = value, status 176 controlChange, 224 pitchBend, 208 channelPressure, 192 programChange, 160 polyPressure; subposition = position - the bar line at or before it. CONDITIONS are ANDed; all matches; equal x == a; unequal x != a; lessEqual x <= a; greaterEqual x >= a; inside a <= x <= b; outside x < a || x > b. SELECTION: P0 and P1 are the least and greatest position of the matching events before any operation; for exponent on length, L0 and L1 the least and greatest length of the matching notes. OPERATIONS apply to each matching event in the field order position, length, channel, pitch, velocity (whatever their order in the list; at most one per field; none on status or subposition). With x the field's current value: thru x; fix a; add x + a; subtract x - a; min max(x, a); max min(x, a); flip 2a - x, but on position P0 + P1 + 2a - x; multiply x * a, on position P0 + (x - P0) * a; divide x / a (a = 0: x), on position P0 + (x - P0) / a; scale x * a + b, on position P0 + (x - P0) * a + b; range clamp(x, min(a, b), max(a, b)); random an integer in round(min(a, b))…round(max(a, b)); plusMinusRandom x + an integer in -round(|a|)…round(|a|); quantize round(x / a) * a (a <= 0: x); exponent lo + ((x - lo) / (hi - lo))^a * (hi - lo), the ratio clamped to 0…1, with lo…hi the field's range (channel 1…16, pitch 0…127, velocity as below), P0…P1 for position and L0…L1 for length (a <= 0 or hi <= lo: x); crescendo a + (b - a) * t and relativeCrescendo x + a + (b - a) * t, t = (p - P0) / (P1 - P0) by the event's ORIGINAL position p (0 when P1 = P0); useMap map[round(x)] when round(x) is 0…127 (map absent: round(x)), else x. Each result is rounded half away from zero, then clamped: position >= 0, a note's length >= 1, channel 1…16, pitch 0…127, a note's velocity 1…127, a pitch bend's -8192…8191, other controllers' 0…127. A controller has no length, and only controlChange and polyPressure have a pitch: an operation on a field an event lacks leaves it (but still draws, below). RANDOM: each matching event has its own SplitMix64, state = seed XOR (id * 0xD1B54A32D192ED03) (unsigned 64-bit, wrapping; seed as two's complement); next(): state += 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15; z = state; z = (z ^ (z >> 30)) * 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9; z = (z ^ (z >> 27)) * 0x94D049BB133111EB; return z ^ (z >> 31). Every random and plusMinusRandom operation draws one next(), in field order, whether or not the event has the field; an integer in lo…hi is lo + next() mod (hi - lo + 1). `draws` pins the first numbers of some generators (decimal strings). Factory presets (ids factory.*) have seed 0; the editor draws a new seed when it applies a random one.
